questions.question: Dr. Meriem asks Dr. Sofia: 'What is the first step to prepare my maternity leave?' Sofia replies:
options: Establish a replacement plan and schedule
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia explains: 'The first step is to establish a replacement plan and schedule to ensure continuity of care.' Meriem: 'I will start right away.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem wonders: 'How to choose my replacement?' Sofia replies:
options: Look for a trusted, competent, and available colleague
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia explains: 'The replacement must be competent, reliable, and share your professional values.' Meriem: 'I will look in my network.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem asks: 'When should I start looking for a replacement?' Sofia replies:
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia explains: 'Ideally, start looking 3 to 6 months before. This gives you time to find the right person.' Meriem: 'I will start right away.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem wonders: 'How to inform my patients?' Sofia replies:
options: Inform them by mail or email 2 months before
Inform them the day before departure
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia explains: 'Early and clear communication reassures patients about the continuity of care.' Meriem: 'I will prepare a message.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem asks: 'What are my administrative obligations during leave?' Sofia replies:
options: Appoint a replacement and inform patients
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia explains: 'As a liberal professional, you must appoint a replacement and inform your patients. This is an ethical obligation.' Meriem: 'I will inquire about the procedures.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem wonders: 'What are my rights during maternity leave?' Sofia replies:
options: 14 weeks of leave and CNSS allowances
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia explains: 'The Labor Code provides for 14 weeks of leave and CNSS daily allowances.' Meriem: 'I will check with CNSS.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem asks: 'How to manage fixed expenses during my absence?' Sofia replies:
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia explains: 'CNSS allowances can cover part of the expenses. You should also plan a precautionary savings.' Meriem: 'I will prepare a budget.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem wonders: 'How to manage breastfeeding at work?' Sofia replies:
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia explains: 'Arrange dedicated times to express milk. Inform your assistant and patients.' Meriem: 'I will plan breaks.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem asks: 'How to manage the guilt of leaving my practice?' Sofia replies:
options: Accept that it is a necessity
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia explains: 'Guilt is normal, but it should not prevent you from taking care of yourself. Trust your replacement.' Meriem: 'I will learn to let go.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem wonders: 'How to prepare my return?' Sofia replies:
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia explains: 'A gradual return allows you to readjust smoothly.' Meriem: 'I will plan half-days.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem asks: 'What support is available for women dentists?' Sofia replies:
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia explains: 'There are networks and associations of women dentists that offer support and advice.' Meriem: 'I will join an association.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem wonders: 'How to manage the stress of returning?' Sofia replies:
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia explains: 'Returning to work is a key moment. You need to give yourself time and breaks.' Meriem: 'I will take care of myself.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem asks: 'How to manage fatigue after a difficult night?' Sofia replies:
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia explains: 'Fatigue is a real challenge. Adjust your hours and plan breaks.' Meriem: 'I will adapt my schedule.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem wonders: 'How to retain my patients during my absence?' Sofia replies:
options: Communicate regularly via newsletter or social media
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia explains: 'Regular communication maintains the bond with patients.' Meriem: 'I will prepare newsletters.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem asks: 'How to handle unexpected events during my leave?' Sofia replies:
options: Have a Plan B and an emergency contact
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia explains: 'A Plan B and an emergency contact help manage unexpected events.' Meriem: 'I will prepare a backup plan.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem wonders: 'How to balance family and professional life?' Sofia replies:
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia explains: 'The key is delegation and the art of saying no.' Meriem: 'I will learn to delegate.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem asks: 'How to handle patients unhappy with the replacement?' Sofia replies:
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia explains: 'Listening and reassurance are essential to maintain trust.' Meriem: 'I will prepare reassuring responses.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem wonders: 'How to evaluate the replacement's performance?' Sofia replies:
options: Ask for feedback from patients and the assistant
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia explains: 'Feedback from patients and the assistant are good indicators.' Meriem: 'I will have a meeting with my assistant.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem asks: 'How to handle the legal aspects of replacement?' Sofia replies:
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia explains: 'A clear replacement contract protects both parties.' Meriem: 'I will consult a lawyer for the contract.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem wonders: 'How to manage my image during my absence?' Sofia replies:
options: Maintain a presence on social media
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia explains: 'A light presence on social media maintains the bond with patients.' Meriem: 'I will post dental tips.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem asks: 'How to prepare my team for my absence?' Sofia replies:
options: Train the team and clarify roles
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia explains: 'A well-prepared team ensures continuity of care.' Meriem: 'I will organize a meeting with my team.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem wonders: 'How to handle patients who refuse the replacement?' Sofia replies:
options: Reassure them and offer an alternative
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia explains: 'Reassuring and offering an alternative is the best approach.' Meriem: 'I will prepare reassuring arguments.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem asks: 'How to manage stress during pregnancy?' Sofia replies:
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia explains: 'Relaxation and breathing help manage stress.' Meriem: 'I will learn breathing techniques.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem wonders: 'How to handle patients' looks at my pregnancy?' Sofia replies:
options: Talk about it openly if she wishes
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia explains: 'Pregnancy is wonderful news. Share it with your patients if you wish.' Meriem: 'I will talk to my patients about it.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem, after mastering the aspects of leave with Sofia, says: 'I am ready to leave serenely!' Sofia concludes: 'Mastering maternity leave is...'
options: The foundation of a fulfilling career
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia explains: 'Mastering maternity leave is the foundation of a fulfilling career.' Meriem: 'I will leave with complete peace of mind.'
